newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) down.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) down.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Saturday, issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and are annual percentage rates.
The central bank does not post volumes.
Traders said the rates moved in a narrow range in very slow trading because of lack of interest before the four-day National Day holiday starting on Sunday.
State commercial banks were net lenders while short-term financial centres and money brokerages run by the central bank were net borrowers, traders said.
"Few investors would like to trade before the long holiday," a trader said. "Dull trade made rate movements insignificant."
Traders said they expected the rates to move in a narrow band in slow trading in the first few days after the market re-opens next Thursday. -- Shanghai newsroom (86-21) 6279-7004
